```markdown
## Context

The command-line importer reads an input file and imports its contents.

## Problem

When the command-line importer is given an empty input file, it reports success instead of rejecting the input.

A zero-byte input file passed to the importer reports success.

source: attachment: import-session.txt

scenario: setup: a zero-byte input file; action: pass the file to the importer; observed: the importer reports success; inputs: attachment: import-session.txt

## Idea

The reporter asks that the importer reject empty input instead of reporting success.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The importer rejects empty input.
```
